message: My battery is dead in the Kroger parking lot on Route 9 and my kids are with me. Please send someone.
notes: Immediate roadside need — outranks any billing/policy content.

message: This is the third time you've denied my claim. I've already contacted an attorney and I'll be calling the state insurance commissioner tomorrow.
notes: Regulator + lawyer language — ESCALATION outranks CLAIMS.

message: My daughter turned 16 last week and got her license. Can you add her to my auto policy? Also, does adding her change my premium?
notes: Premium question is subsidiary — the actionable ask is a policy change.
